subject.title: fix(config): apply SPAWN_ALLOWLIST env for sessions_spawn (#79490)

question: Should `OPENCLAW_SPAWN_ALLOWLIST`/`SPAWN_ALLOWLIST` become a supported fallback for Docker-only configuration, while explicit `openclaw.json` allowlists remain authoritative?
rationale: This is a new authorization-related environment contract; source review can establish the unsafe overwrite, but cannot choose the long-term operator precedence policy.

options.title: Adopt fallback-only semantics
options.body: Read the environment value only when no explicit `agents.defaults.subagents.allowAgents` value is configured, document it, and add precedence coverage.

options.title: Keep environment authoritative
options.body: Accept that redeploy environment changes override persisted spawn authorization and document the upgrade and security implications.

options.title: Decline the env surface
options.body: Keep the existing canonical config path and direct Docker users to configure `agents.defaults.subagents.allowAgents` through the supported configuration mechanism.

recommendation.title: Adopt fallback-only semantics
recommendation.body: Read the environment value only when no explicit `agents.defaults.subagents.allowAgents` value is configured, document it, and add precedence coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged subagent-target-policy work owns the current wildcard and allowlist contract that this decision would extend.
